crossRefs.note: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or…
What the wicked fear, will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they…
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
